info.name: EduSphere
info.description:
EduSphere University Management System — complete API collection.

Set `baseURL` in collection variables. Login/Verify Email/Google Login/Refresh Token automatically save `accessToken` and `refreshToken`. Creating a department/program/course/semester/section/student-section and submitting an application automatically saves `departmentId`, `programId`, `courseId`, `semesterId`, `sectionId`, `studentSectionId`, and `applicationId`. Set `instructorId` manually (an InstructorProfile id) before creating a section with an instructor.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP to the email. Verify in the next step to complete registration.
Verifies the OTP, creates the user account, and returns JWT tokens (also set as httpOnly cookies).
Authenticates a user and returns JWT tokens.
Returns the authenticated user's profile. Roles: ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR, STUDENT, SUPER_ADMIN.
Issues new tokens using the refreshToken cookie.
Authenticates or registers a user via Google OAuth using a Google ID token.
Sends a 6-digit OTP to the user's email for password reset.
Resets the user's password using the OTP from Forgot Password.
Creates a department. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN. Saves the new id to `departmentId`.
Lists departments (soft-deleted excluded) with search and pagination. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Returns a single department. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Updates a department. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Soft-deletes a department. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Creates a program under a department. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN. Saves the new id to `programId`.
Lists programs (soft-deleted excluded) with department filter, search, and pagination. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Returns a single program (with department). Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Updates a program. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Soft-deletes a program. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Submits an enrollment application. `fullName` is taken from the authenticated user. Role: STUDENT. Saves the new id to `applicationId`.
Edits a PENDING/REJECTED application and resets it to PENDING. Role: STUDENT.
Returns the current user's enrollment application (or null). Role: STUDENT.
Returns the full user profile with StudentProfile and StudentApplication. Role: STUDENT.
Updates fullName and/or phone on the StudentProfile. Role: STUDENT (requires approved profile).
Uploads a profile image (multipart/form-data, field `avatar`). Role: STUDENT.
Lists ENROLLED/COMPLETED registrations. Role: STUDENT. Saves the first registration id to `registrationId`.
Returns a registration with section detail, exam results, and attendance. Role: STUDENT.
Returns attendance grouped by section with counts and percentage. Role: STUDENT.
Returns grades grouped by course. Role: STUDENT.
Returns grade details for one registration. Role: STUDENT.
Computes and returns the student's CGPA. Role: STUDENT.
Lists all enrollment applications, optionally filtered by status. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN. Saves the first application id to `applicationId`.
Approves a PENDING application, creates the StudentProfile, notifies, and sends the welcome email. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Rejects a PENDING application with an optional note, notifies, and sends the rejection email. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Assigns/clears a student's fixed academic section (`:id` = StudentProfile id; `null` clears). Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Sets a student's studentStatus (PENDING/ACTIVE/INACTIVE/GRADUATED/DROPPED_OUT). Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Creates a course (optionally with prerequisites). Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN. Saves the new id to `courseId`.
Lists courses with department and prerequisites. Roles: any authenticated.
Fetches a course by id. Roles: any authenticated.
Updates a course; `prerequisiteIds` replaces the prerequisite set. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Hard-deletes a course (cascades sections + prerequisites). Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Creates a semester (setting isActive deactivates all others). Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN. Saves the new id to `semesterId`.
Lists semesters with section/student counts. Roles: any authenticated.
Fetches a semester by id. Roles: any authenticated.
Updates a semester. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Deletes a semester; blocked (409) if sections exist. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Creates a section for a course + semester (optional instructor). Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN. Saves the new id to `sectionId`.
Lists sections with course, semester, and instructor. Roles: any authenticated.
Fetches a section by id. Roles: any authenticated.
Updates sectionCode/instructorId/capacity/schedule (course and semester are immutable). Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Assigns an instructor to a section. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Hard-deletes a section (cascades registrations/attendance/exams/results). Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Creates a student's fixed academic section (program + enrollment year + code). Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN. Saves the new id to `studentSectionId`.
Lists student sections with `enrolledCount` and `seatsAvailable`. Roles: any authenticated.
Fetches a student section by id (includes seat counts). Roles: any authenticated.
Updates sectionCode/capacity (program + year immutable; capacity can't drop below enrolled). Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
Hard-deletes a student section; 409 if students are assigned. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.
